capabilities: Collect open todos from the vault into a side panel
Check off todos and write the change back to the source file
Reorder todos and move them between notes by drag and drop
Filter todos by scope, date notes and exclusion rules
Roll open todos from past daily notes into today's note
disambiguation: Not a tool for inserting checklists into notes; it collects existing Markdown todos into a side panel.
extras: Checking off a todo in the panel triggers a confetti burst, and the todo stays greyed out for 5 seconds so it can be unchecked; completion times are recorded for the last 30 days regardless of the display setting.
problem: Open todos are spread across many notes, so reviewing and checking them off means opening each file in turn.
summary: Side panel that gathers every open todo in the vault into one list to check off, reorder and jump to.
